description: Defines a template class 'RecorderType' for recording and managing time-stamped measurement data with delta compression, including nested classes for reading and writing recordings, and handling serialization/deserialization.
published: template <typename STOREVALUE, const unsigned int BLOCKSIZE> class RecorderType

classes.name: RecorderType
classes.description: A template class for recording time-stamped measurements with delta compression, supporting reading and writing of measurement data.

classes.name: RecorderType<STOREVALUE, BLOCKSIZE>::BaseRecorder
classes.description: Base class managing buffer, start/end data, and serialization/deserialization of measurement data.

classes.name: RecorderType<STOREVALUE, BLOCKSIZE>::Writer
classes.description: Handles recording measurements, buffering, and saving data to files.

classes.name: RecorderType<STOREVALUE, BLOCKSIZE>::Reader
classes.description: Handles reading measurement data from files, supporting navigation through recorded measurements.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores a measurement with timestamp and value, updating internal state and delta encoding.

methods.name: StepForward
methods.description: Advances to the next measurement, updating internal state based on delta decoding.

methods.name: StepBack
methods.description: Moves to the previous measurement, updating internal state based on delta decoding.

methods.name: SnapShot
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current recorder state.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads measurement data from a file into the recorder.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves measurement data to a file.

methods.name: ClearData
methods.description: Resets the recorder data to initial state.
